segments.text: Explaining my entire day trading strategy in under a minute or I have to jump in the pool.
The first thing you do is you go on ES Futures or NQ.
You go on the one-hour time frame.
You mark out the untested session highs and lows of Asia, London, and New York trading session.

You then mark out the first fifty-minute candle from eight to fifteen AM Eastern Standard Time, and you wait for price to break either above or below this candle, and then you wait for it to retest the midpoint and continue moving in the same direction it broke out to.
When we're trading NQ, we are targeting between fifty and one hundred and fifty points, targeting a one to three risk to reward.
When we're trading ES, we're targeting between twenty and forty points, targeting a one to three risk to reward.
I also like to trade specifically between the hours of nine and eleven AM Eastern Standard Time every single day.
The only other time I will trade is during Asia session, and I will trade gold using this exact same strategy.
I highly recommend having a win rate of between forty and sixty percent with this strategy so that you can still make a lot of money and not obsess over being right every single time.
